name: MTH 323 225 MAX (MTH, 225 gr)

sources.note: Page 2, MTH-Match, Tactical, Hunting: Caliber .323 (8mm), Grains 225, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTH 323 225 MAX, G1 BC .640, G7 BC .317est., OAL 1.704", Bullet Projection 1.139"
